scope: Single model call without retrieval, agent planning, reflection, or revision. Frozen development questions.
questionContext: Keep context supplied by the official task itself; add no retrieved evidence or empty evidence header.
sourceAuditScope: Inherited reference-corpus audit for paired comparison only; corpus and indexes are not used for inference.
failurePolicy: Checkpoint provider failures without retries; paired reports exclude refusals in either arm, other failures remain zero.

primaryScorePolicy: Exclude provider biology refusals only; retain other call/parse/evaluator failures as zero. Original allQuestionScores and official metrics are preserved for audit.

storedBaselineComparison.scope: Single draws on previously analyzed development samples; baseline predictions stored, not rerun. Call failures score zero. No causal or fresh-holdout claim.

pairedNonRefusals.policy: Exclude provider refusals in either arm; other failures remain zero; conditioning on responses can introduce selection bias.
